name: Shelter of Sursur 2
storyline: After you left elevator platform, you go to an orange room with tables on the left and right. you see a button and press it and it activates a test. The test gives you the task to collet a tray, battery and box. Then you must get a glowing ball and roll it until you see Sursur. He tells you to go to the elevator and then you get knocked out. We wake up and see Sursurlara. we activate the 3 buttons and Sursur chases the Player, he gets knocked out and he wake up at the parkour course. After that. The Player opens the door and sees a long orange coridor. Sursurlara chases you towards the elevator as you go down, she stops running at you.
summary:
Take a look at the dark shelter opposite your house to find your missing child…

Solve all the puzzles while avoiding being chased by the monsters inside Sursur's shelter.
